citation.journal: Transactions of the Royal Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene

cited_by.title: Head lice in afro-textured hair and locs

record.population: 1,270 schoolchildren, 33 urban and rural primary schools, Kenya
record.finding: 17.1% were infested (8% with living lice or nits). Negroid children had lower infestation rates than non-Negroid children, and the authors say the criterion seems to be hair type. Infestation was higher in older children, in children with longer hair and in those who washed less; most had one or two lice.
record.note: Old; the paper's own terms; hair type not measured.
